frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Brock-Hommes adaptive belief system: agents endogenously switch among forecasting rules according to past realized profit via a discrete-choice (logit) rule, with the intensity-of-choice beta governing how sharply they chase the more profitable strategy.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Brock-Hommes Adaptive Belief Switching
